notes: The tuition-fee page is an institution-wide table, not the programme's own page; the row for Environmental Engineering* appears in the Bachelor programs table with fee 6,500 USD/year, but the extracted quote is ambiguous about whether that fee belongs to Environmental Engineering or Biology. The programme page itself (Studyfinder) states no tuition. Intake deadline: the programme page states a general application deadline of 15 June without a year, quoted from the University of Debrecen admission page; the year 2026 comes from a sentence about the September 2026/2027 intake, but the programme itself may only be applied for September, so the deadline is recurring. Tuition currency is USD as stated on the pages, not converted.

note.fr: Les candidats doivent réussir des examens d'entrée écrits et oraux en mathématiques et en physique ou chimie. Résultats : 75 % et plus = admission ; 60-75 % = programme préparatoire.
note.en: Applicants must pass written and oral entrance exams in mathematics and physics or chemistry. Results: 75%+ admission; 60-75% preparatory programme.

evidence.quote: Results about 75% and over mean admission to the selected programme, results between 60%-75% -admission to a preparatory (foundation year) programme.
